a_identity.definition: release validation batch = release rows (training_manifest.csv) whose CNV sample is a sample of this sheet (docs/dataset_description.md 268-sheet stratum)
a_identity.rule: the sheet is taken to be (or to contain) the rejected batch if any of its patients has a sample among the release rows

b_linkage.linkage: sheet Block -> case + block (r2_main.py ckey / vblock) = slide_matching PathCaseID + Block, slide embedded in uni2_npz_map.csv; batch = sequencing run (SLXID1; the sheet has no Batch column)

c_metadata_alone.model: L2 logistic (C = 1) on scanner and sequencing run (one-hot), log(1 + tissue tiles) and biopsy year, training-standardised; patient-grouped folds stratified by patient status, 10 folds x 10 repeats (seeds 1-10); fold-stratified AUROC, mean over repeats; patient bootstrap 2,000 draws

R56.note: audit only; no outcome-based score of the slide model was computed
